Dinner started off good but poor service ended the night badly
Jan 2019 • Family
We are staying at the Hyatt Regency and went to Pool House tonight for a New Years Day celebration with our family of 5, They had a BBQ buffet inclusive of drinks (alcoholic and soft drinks), which they promoted it as a free flow. The buffet was expensive by Vietnamese standards at around 1,150,000 VND per adult. Children are classified as up to 12 and are half price. From 13 up they are charged as an adult. We have a 14 year old son which makes it expensive as he wasn't drinking alcoholic beverages. The promotional material said the restaurant included a DJ who disappeared by 730pm. All this we can handle no big deal we have travelled a lot in Asia. We had a good night and the food was OK. Then came the bill. Charges for drinks outside the "free flow" appeared. I sent the family back to the villa while sorted it out with the restaurant manager. To cut a long story short we are here for a few more nights and won't be back. The service staff need to improve their communication particularly what is included and what isn't. There are plenty of better options for dinner.

Decently good food and Excellent view
Sep 2018 • Family
We ordered a salad - forgotten the name but it has avocado - big serving, fresh rolls, chicken tight with rice and beef Pho for 2 adults and 1 toddler to share. Did not order any drinks. We seated outside the restaurant facing the ocean. The breeze is good not windy that things fly around, just breeze brushing across your face as you looked out to the ocean with their waves in and out, people walking along the beach, some in the water, children playing and digging the sand, a couple or two in the hammock, white clouds, blue sky, and you witness the sky getting darker, the sun turns more orange and finally sets beyond the horizon, and all the lamp and garden lights were on - it was a great feeling. A complete picture indeed.
